title: Config fact manifest
description: 200 response to GET /api/v1/manifest/config (FR-2.1, P2-S01): the versioned list of configuration facts an agent may report. The manifest names fact keys only, never commands. A fact is never removed, renamed, or given another type, so a report made against an older manifest_version stays valid. Sent with a strong ETag; `If-None-Match` gives `304`.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. This directory is version 1.

manifest_version.description: The manifest's version. A config report states the version it was made against, and the facts it must contain are those with `since` up to that version.

facts.description: Every fact, sorted by key. `file:<path>` facts are the files the server wants the mode, owner, and group of; `service:<unit>` facts are the systemd units it wants the state of.

key.description: The fact's key, as used in a config report: a dotted name such as `sshd.permitrootlogin`, `file:<absolute path>`, or `service:<unit name>`.

type.description: The value type: `string`, `integer`, `boolean`, `string_list`, `file_attributes` (`{mode, owner, group}` or `null` for no such file), or `service_state` (`{active, enabled}` or `null` for no such unit).

since.description: The manifest version that introduced the fact.

description.description: What the fact is, for the operator.

max_items.description: `string_list`: the most entries. An agent reports no more than this.
